children: BioPorto A/S enrolled the first patient in its U.S. Adult Urine NGAL Validation Study at Massachusetts General Hospital, targeting ~900 ICU patients to support a potential adult indication for ProNephro AKI (NGAL).
First adult patient enrolled in U.S.
Marks transition to validation phase toward a potential U.S. adult indication, expanding market scope.
Large sample size boosts statistical power; faster completion could pull forward timelines.
Top-tier site participation can aid enrollment pace and regulatory credibility.
Operational continuity may reduce execution risk versus onboarding a new CRO.
Adult indication would materially expand addressable U.S. market if achieved.

This is an early-to-mid stage clinical step following an adult AKI cut-off study, aiming to broaden NGAL use to adults in the U.S. For a larger catalyst, the study must complete enrollment and deliver positive validation data to support FDA submission for an adult indication.
Based on the original press release from BioPorto A/S distributed by GlobeNewswire.
